# Poetae Minores Graeci, vol. II: the ancient and Byzantine scholia on Hesiod (Proclus Diadochus, John Tzetzes and the anonymous scholia on the Works and Days, and the scholia on the Theogony), edited by Thomas Gaisford

- **Title:** Poetae Minores Graeci, vol. II: the ancient and Byzantine scholia on Hesiod (Proclus Diadochus, John Tzetzes and the anonymous scholia on the Works and Days, and the scholia on the Theogony), edited by Thomas Gaisford
- **Author:** Proclus Diadochus; John Tzetzes; anonymous scholiasts; edited by Thomas Gaisford (1779-1855) on Hesiod
- **Edition:** Leipzig: Kuehn, 1823 (Gaisford, Poetae minores graeci, new edition with the annotations of F. V. Reiz on Hesiod; Internet Archive item poetaeminoresgra02gais; 50,622 lines of OCR). The volume holds the Greek scholia from manuscripts, the lives of Hesiod, and notes in Latin; headings found in it: Proclus Diadochus (Προκλου Διαδοχου), John Tzetzes (Ιωαννου του Τζετζου), Scholia on the Works and Days, Scholia on the Theogony.
- **Translator:** none (Greek scholia; Latin notes)
- **Year:** 1823
- **Read from:** https://archive.org/download/poetaeminoresgra02gais/poetaeminoresgra02gais_djvu.txt
- **Licence / copyright status:** Public domain (ancient and Byzantine texts; the 1823 edition, Gaisford died 1855).
